n = int(input())
s = input()

positions = [-1]
for i, ch in enumerate(s):
    if ch == '(' or ch == ')':
        positions.append(i)

totalWordsInBraces = 0
maxWordLength = 0
outsideStr = ""

i = 1
while i < len(positions) - 1:
    startIdx = positions[i]
    endIdx = positions[i + 1]
    insideStr = s[startIdx + 1:endIdx]
    insideStr = insideStr.replace('_', ' ').strip()
    parts = insideStr.split()
    countWords = len(parts)
    totalWordsInBraces += countWords
    prev_end = positions[i - 1] + 1
    outsideStr += "_" + s[prev_end:startIdx]
    i += 2

outsideStr += "_" + s[positions[-1] + 1:]
outsideStr = outsideStr.replace('_', ' ').strip()
outsideWords = outsideStr.split()

for w in outsideWords:
    if len(w) > maxWordLength:
        maxWordLength = len(w)

print(f"{maxWordLength} {totalWordsInBraces}")
